run_main_training: run the SunCeT semi-supervised contrastive learning training loop with a config dict containing meta, criterion, data, optimization, and logging sections
init_model_encoder: build a ResNet or WideResNet encoder with a 3-layer projection head and optional prediction head for self-supervised learning
init_opt_optimizer: create an LARS-wrapped SGD optimizer with WarmupCosineSchedule learning rate scheduler for the encoder model
load_checkpoint_resume: load a saved training checkpoint to restore the encoder, optimizer, and epoch state for resuming training
review_main_config: review the main training function to understand how config args drive model init, data loading, loss computation, and checkpointing
